newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down after one-day gain.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down after one-day gain.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to return to their slight downtrend on Thursday after Wednesday's 0.4-percent gain, signalled by stronger selling after price-fixing and at continuous trade.

Analysts said macroeconomic uncertainties which could dampen share buying, such as a shaky currency and current account deficit, were deepened by expected government borrowing from the central bank to pay for damage from recent flooding.

They said main market sentiment would likely not be hurt by Tuesday's news the Securities Commission notified the public prosecutor that a group of investors may have illegally manipulated prices, saying more players may seek blue chips.
